purpose: Measure end-to-end coding correctness and efficiency on natural merged-PR tasks in unfamiliar medium-to-very-large repositories; do not optimize or grade individual Greppy commands.
release_claim_scope: Greppy 0.3.0 treatment versus the same agent without Greppy, with identical model, prompt budget, standard tools, environment, repository snapshot, and grading.

task_class_definitions.reported_bugfix: A user-observable defect with a reproduction or falsifiable expected behavior.
task_class_definitions.feature_implementation: A new user-visible capability described by an issue or accepted PR requirement.
task_class_definitions.cross_cutting_behavior: One behavior must be changed consistently across modules, implementations, or call sites.
task_class_definitions.api_or_config_migration: A public or internal API, schema, configuration, serialization, or compatibility transition with downstream updates.
task_class_definitions.behavior_preserving_refactor: A structural change motivated by maintainability, performance, or architecture and protected by behavior tests.
task_class_definitions.robustness_validation: Validation, error handling, boundary behavior, concurrency safety, or malformed-input handling with an observable failure mode.

temporal_holdout.unknown_or_later_model_cutoff_policy: Results may be reported as sealed-corpus results, but must not be described as contamination-free; build a new post-cutoff corpus for that model.
temporal_holdout.public_release_policy: Keep candidate identities, task statements, snapshots, tests, and gold patches private until every preregistered arm and rerun is complete.
temporal_holdout.rolling_refresh_policy: Each later model or Greppy release uses a newly harvested window and new opaque task IDs; V2 tasks and prior V3 tasks are never reused for a fresh-contamination claim.

repository_scale.eligible_source_definition: Tracked, non-vendored, non-generated files in the registry primary language; tests count for repository scale but not production-patch size.
repository_scale.failure_policy: A registry repository below the hard medium floor must be replaced by preregistration amendment before sealing; task quotas may never be moved to another existing repository.

required: PR is merged and its base, head, merge strategy, merge result, issue/PR text, and timestamps are captured from authoritative metadata.
PR changes at least two non-test production or runtime-configuration paths and at least one behavior test path.
Production diff changes 40 through 1200 non-generated lines across 2 through 20 production paths.
Full PR diff changes at most 30 paths and does not consist primarily of formatting, snapshots, generated files, vendored files, or dependency lockfiles.
Natural issue states a falsifiable outcome without relying on the gold diff; the agent prompt is the issue title plus issue body verbatim, not an authored benchmark instruction.
The task is executable offline after dependency materialization and has a focused grader command with a 30-minute hard ceiling.
The task can be graded on Linux x86_64 on gpu3 without privileged services or mutable third-party state.
excluded: documentation-only, test-only, benchmark-only, formatting-only, generated-only, vendor-only, or dependency-bump-only changes
security embargoes, credential-bearing fixtures, telemetry or network-dependent tests, nondeterministic performance-only claims, and tasks requiring paid services
PR text or linked discussion containing a complete patch, direct solution commit, or copy-pastable implementation
tasks already present in SWE-bench, V2, another published coding benchmark, or a previous Greppy release corpus
tasks selected because Greppy succeeds, because a particular Greppy command is expected to apply, or because exploratory arm results are favorable
candidate_admission.merge_reconstruction: Use the exact target-branch parent immediately before the merged result and the exact merged result tree. Prove that the reconstructed gold delta contains the PR change and no unrelated target-branch drift; reject ambiguous rebases instead of assuming a parent.
candidate_admission.navigation_pressure_is_repository_level: The large unfamiliar repository and cross-file production change create the navigation requirement. No task prompt names or requests Greppy commands, and tool-use counts never affect task admission.

required_proofs: parent snapshot passes the scoped pre-existing baseline test
parent plus sealed FAIL_TO_PASS tests fails for the intended assertion or compile reason
gold production patch plus sealed FAIL_TO_PASS tests passes
the preregistered PASS_TO_PASS set passes on both parent and gold states
the complete merged result passes the same focused grader
grader tests are nonempty and touch no production path
gold production patch is nonempty and contains no grader-test path
two clean-room repetitions reproduce parent-fail and gold-pass
task setup and grader complete offline from pinned dependency caches
reject_on: test failure unrelated to task intent
validation.test_visibility: The agent receives only the verbatim issue title/body and parent snapshot. Sealed FAIL_TO_PASS is applied only after the agent phase; PASS_TO_PASS definitions and gold remain unavailable to the agent.
validation.grading_isolation: Grade from a fresh parent snapshot by applying the captured agent patch, then the sealed grader tests. The grader executable and sealed tests are outside the agent-writable tree.

selection.unit: repository plus task class slot from repository_registry.json
selection.classification_time: Classify from frozen issue/PR metadata before running either benchmark arm.
selection.ranking: After all candidates and validation verdicts are frozen, rank passing candidates inside each repository/class stratum by HMAC-SHA256(selection_secret, canonical_candidate_id).
selection.selection_secret: Generate before metadata harvest, store only with sealed corpus materials, and publish after all benchmark runs.
selection.replacement: If a selected candidate fails final clean-room validation, use the next ranked passing candidate from the same repository and task class only.
selection.forbidden_backfill: Never replace a missing repository/class slot with another class, language, or repository.
selection.unfillable_slot: Before seal, amend the registry while preserving language, pattern, quota, and scale. After seal, the 144-task release corpus fails qualification.
selection.blinding: Corpus selectors may inspect metadata, diffs, and tests for validity but may not inspect benchmark-arm outcomes before the corpus hash is sealed.

exact_keys: canonical repository plus parent tree plus normalized issue URL
deduplication.near_duplicate_policy: Manual blinded review is required above 0.80 similarity; retain at most one task from a duplicate family.

agent_snapshot.format: deterministic parent-tree archive imported into a new one-commit Git repository
agent_snapshot.task_id: Keyed opaque identifier with at least 120 bits of output; no visible repository, issue, parent, PR, or gold prefix. The ID key stays sealed until all runs finish.
agent_snapshot.network: Deny agent process and all child-process network egress. Dependency caches are materialized before the measured run.
agent_snapshot.filesystem: Run the agent under an identity or sandbox that can access only its task worktree, its Greppy store, explicit read-only toolchains/dependency caches, and its raw-trace output. It cannot read builder clones or any NAS corpus/gold/evidence path.

experimental_arms.control: Same coding agent with modern shell navigation including rg plus identical read/edit/write tool schemas and no Greppy treatment text.
experimental_arms.treatment: Same coding agent with the identical normal tools and the exact shipped 0.3.0 AGENTS.md loaded at run time as the only intended prompt treatment.
identical: system prompt except the exact shipped AGENTS.md treatment text
experimental_arms.treatment_identity: Read AGENTS.md from the exact release worktree at run time and record its SHA-256. Embedded paraphrases and stale copied command guides are forbidden.
experimental_arms.baseline_search: rg must be installed and usable in the control arm. A control prompt may not deny grep, rg, read, edit, or write.
experimental_arms.task_prompt_policy: Use the issue title and body verbatim. Never append an instruction to invoke where-am-i, search, navigation, read, edit, or any other individual Greppy capability.
primary_outcomes: total provider cost across every attempted task and retry
diagnostic_only: workspace dirty state immediately after every failed edit

required_lines: static treatment bytes and tokenizer-estimated tokens
provider-reported treatment prompt tokens per turn and summed per trajectory
gross input tokens and provider cost including treatment overhead
descriptive variable-token total after subtracting treatment overhead
prompt_overhead_reporting.headline_policy: Correctness and cost comparisons use gross provider totals. The overhead-subtracted number is diagnostic and may not replace the gross result.
prompt_overhead_reporting.summary_statistics: Report paired median, arithmetic mean, confidence interval, and n for cost, tokens, and wall time.

experimental_arms.source_open_accounting: Count every source-bearing output regardless of tool: built-in read, cat/head/tail/sed, greppy read, greppy read-smart, greppy read-file, and any Greppy command using --code. No arm-specific exemptions.
experimental_arms.censoring: Use identical turn, token, and timeout caps. Report cap hits separately as censored trajectories; never silently convert a cap hit into a capability failure or omit its cost.
experimental_arms.zero_denominator: Any rate metric with zero eligible events is N/A and cannot pass a gate. Emit the zero denominator and reason explicitly.

execution_modes.container: Host requires git, rg, Docker 27.2+, pi and exact Greppy 0.3.0. Every repository adapter binds a digest-pinned image and proves its language toolchain with network=none.
execution_modes.host: Host requires git, rg, Docker, pi, Greppy 0.3.0 and all eight language toolchains directly.

execution_preflight.maven_blocker: JDK 17 and Maven 3.9.9 are installed on gpu3 NVMe but must be exposed by deployment through JAVA_HOME/PATH and version-probed. An unavailable or mismatched Maven remains a hard failure, never a reason to drop Java tasks or backfill another repository.
execution_preflight.adapter_check: Every repository row must bind a digest-pinned image and complete proof/metadata/validation argv commands. With network=none, --preflight probes must prove the profile toolchain plus rg, pi and exact Greppy 0.3.0 in the productive image/runtime. The adapter then proves setup, test extraction, hidden FAIL_TO_PASS, and PASS_TO_PASS on gpu3; no row may be silently dropped.
execution_preflight.storage_check: Resolve and validate the distinct NVMe and NAS roots and record filesystem identity/free space before cloning or running an agent.
execution_preflight.offline_check: Prove setup and grading from pinned local dependency caches with agent egress disabled.
execution_preflight.single_commit_check: Inside every agent sandbox, git rev-list --all --count must equal 1 and no remote or alternates may exist.
execution_preflight.signed_evidence: A productive invocation requires a detached operations signature over an attestation hashing the ready gpu3 report and exactly matching the current runner, gate/pricing contracts, Greppy binary, AGENTS.md, provider extension, model, image, network proof, and read-only dependency tree bindings.

trajectory_smoke.selection: Choose three preregistered tasks spanning at least three languages, at least two task classes, and both a lower- and upper-complexity candidate; run complete paired trajectories under the final prompt, binary, limits, storage, and sandbox contract.
manual_review_required: read both complete arm traces for every smoke task
confirm the treatment guide contains only live 0.3.0 vocabulary
confirm no command-not-found or repeated refusal loop
confirm no unbounded single-command output or context-size burst
confirm source-open and failed-edit dirty-state instrumentation
confirm hidden tests appear only after agent termination
confirm provider usage and prompt overhead reconcile
trajectory_smoke.gate: The 144-task full run may not start until all smoke findings are fixed and signed evidence for exactly three reviewed paired trajectories (six arm traces) matches the current preflight and runtime bindings. A prompt, binary, harness, adapter, model, image, dependency, price, gate, or limit change after smoke invalidates the smoke.

release_gate.population: Exactly all 144 sealed tasks with both preregistered arms; subset runs are smoke-only and cannot release.

correctness_noninferiority.estimand: Paired treatment-minus-control sealed-grader correctness over all 144 tasks.
correctness_noninferiority.confidence_bound: Paired bootstrap 95% lower bound with 10000 preregistered deterministic samples.

primary_cost.estimand: Intention-to-treat total provider cost for treatment divided by control across every task and every charged attempt, including failed and censored trajectories; gross prompt overhead remains included.
primary_cost.confidence_bound: Repository-clustered bootstrap 95% upper bound with 10000 preregistered deterministic samples over 24 repository clusters.

mechanism.adoption_definition: A treatment task contains at least one observed Greppy command call.
mechanism.edit_specific_adoption: diagnostic only; it is not a release gate

transactionality.current_observability: unobservable: Pi JSON is post-hoc and has no per-tool before/after hook
transactionality.forbidden_proxy_metric: Do not infer partial workspace state by searching stdout, stderr, or tool-result text.
transactionality.future_gate_requirement: A future gate may be registered only after an interceptor captures git diff and git status hashes immediately before and after every failed Greppy edit, before cleanup.

credential_boundary.current_status: unresolved: agent shell children can read the provider environment and could issue unattributed model calls
credential_boundary.subset_policy: Subset smokes may execute with a scoped ephemeral spend-limited key but are explicitly not cost-valid release evidence.
credential_boundary.full_run_policy: Fail closed before the first full-run trajectory. No Boolean bypass is permitted; enablement requires a separately attestable credential broker, which changes runtime bindings and invalidates prior smoke evidence.

release_gate.fail_closed: Any invalid or incomplete arm, missing cost, missing task, zero denominator, non-finite statistic, failed network/storage/tool/adapter preflight, or changed sealed identity fails the release gate.

storage.host_role: gpu3 executes productive benchmark runs; concrete mountpoints are deployment configuration and are not embedded in the corpus.

requirements: Both resolve to distinct absolute directories.
The harness records resolved device/filesystem identity and free space, but publication redacts host-specific paths.
A run refuses implicit fallback to the repository, home directory, or operating-system temporary directory.

nvme_active: build trees and dependency caches used by active runs
nas_immutable: sealed gold production patches and provenance
storage.publication_flow: Write and fsync active artifacts on NVMe; redact and checksum; stage on the NAS filesystem; atomically publish an immutable evidence directory; verify checksums before deleting or expiring the NVMe copy.
storage.access_separation: Trusted corpus-builder access to gold-bearing NVMe clones and NAS sealed materials is separate from the untrusted agent runtime identity. NAS is not mounted or readable inside agent sandboxes.
storage.retention: Raw active traces remain on NVMe only for bounded debugging retention. Immutable NAS evidence contains redacted traces, manifests, hashes, and results; gold is retained in a separately access-controlled namespace.

required_independent_audits: NVMe-to-NAS evidence checksum and immutability verification
seal_and_audit.post_seal_changes: Any task, test, prompt, model, binary, quota, storage-role, or grading change creates a new corpus/run identity and requires a complete rerun.
